reconciliation: The earlier 149,525,809-byte graph counted named loader aliases but omitted the explicit libnss_files.so.2 root (14,336 bytes), which PostgreSQL _capture adds independently of DT_NEEDED. Adding that required object gives the current logical native-file sum of 149,540,145 bytes across 831 names. Deduplicating /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 and /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2, both the same 236,616-byte physical loader, gives 149,303,529 bytes across 830 physical objects, exactly matching native-capacity-calculation.json. The libpq.so.5 publisher alias resolves to the already-counted libpq.so.5.16 bytes; changing that displayed name adds no bytes. The physical result is the safer conservative lower bound: it exceeds the unchanged 134,217,728-byte combined cap by 15,085,801 bytes even before source/generated entries. The logical sum models current name-preserving capture semantics; neither figure is a successful capture, memory-fit or execution measurement.
